shellCommands.command: /bin/bash -lc "sed -n '1,75p' .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/package-routing.md && cat package.json && cat src/App.tsx && cat src/main.tsx && cat index.html && cat .agents/skills/gravity-ui/rules/hallucination-traps.md"

/bin/bash -lc "rg -n -A 23 '## Page|page-constructor"'`'"' .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/package-routing.md && ls -a && npm view @gravity-ui/page-constructor version peerDependencies --json && .agents/skills/gravity-ui/scripts/inspect-package.sh uikit ThemeProvider Text Button && sed -n '1,150p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/README.md"

/bin/bash -lc "rg -n -C 3 'dynamicImport|import dynamic' node_modules/vite-plugin-dynamic-import/README.md; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/page-constructor/build/esm/blocks/Header/utils.js; rg -n -A 14 'ContentBlockProps|BlockBase|indent\\??:' node_modules/@gravity-ui/page-constructor/build/esm/models/constructor-items/{sub-blocks,common}.d.ts | head -80; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/page-constructor/build/esm/context/localeContext/localeContext.d.ts; rg -n 'className|indent|animated' node_modules/@gravity-ui/page-constructor/build/esm/models/page.d.ts"

/bin/bash -lc "rg --files node_modules/@gravity-ui/page-constructor/build/esm/grid | head -18; rg -n -A 8 '\\.container|\\.pc-container' node_modules/@gravity-ui/page-constructor/styles/styles.css | head -30; rg -n 'text-header|text-display' node_modules/@gravity-ui/page-constructor/build/esm/components/Title/Title.css | head -20; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/page-constructor/build/esm/blocks/ContentLayout/ContentLayout.js | head -42; rg -n 'transition' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Button/Button.css | head -10"
